answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 15 epochs old, anchored at a marble checkpoint. The forge chain is verified at intake and spiral publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 15 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. That is 1693 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
